name: DescribeCheckEcsWarnings

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

CanTry.description_en:
Indicates whether the current Security Center edition is a trial version. Valid values:
0: not a trial version
1: a trial version
CanTry.description_zh:
当前云安全中心版本是否为试用版本。取值：
0：非试用版本
1：试用版本

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

SasVersion.description_en:
The edition of Security Center that you purchased. Valid values:

1: Free Edition
2 or 3: Enterprise Edition  
5: Premium Edition  
6: Anti-virus Edition

Both 2 and 3 correspond to Enterprise Edition. There is no difference between the two values
SasVersion.description_zh:
已购买的云安全中心版本。 取值：

1：免费版
2或3：企业版  
5：高级版  
6：防病毒版

2和3对应的都是企业版，两者对应的版本无差异

WeakPasswordCount.description_en: The number of high-risk weak password risks detected in your assets
WeakPasswordCount.description_zh: 您资产中检测到的高危弱口令风险的数量
